title: Cake Celebrates Ponovezh Victory
body: Attorneys brought cake to Rav Eliezer Kahaneman's home to celebrate a landmark legal victory after a decisive arbitration ruling handed control of Ponovezh Yeshiva to him.

title: Chareidi Draft Orders Advance
body: IDF Chief of Staff sends finalized draft orders for chareidi military service to retired generals for review, signaling official approval may be imminent amid national draft tensions.
